## File layout

| container | format | reader | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GameCube disc image (GCZ -> ISO), FST 1,018 files` | em/ 128 UDAS .drs (22 pl*, em*, wep*), St1/St2/St4 .das stages, Evd, ss, etc, Rel, bgm, Movie (.sfd); main.dol at the header's 0x420 offset, not in the FST | gbox/gcdisc.py (GCDisc), gbox/re4gc_inventory.py | filemods.build_image puts a file in its FST slot when it fits, else after the last file with a new FST entry. |
| `em/plXX.drs, em/emXX.drs` | UDAS big-endian: 0x20 fill, 32-byte entries (type, size, 0, offset), 0xFFFFFFFF, data at 0x400; type 0 DAT model pack, type 4 sound UDAS | gbox/re4gc_models.py (udas_read / udas_write) | Same container as the Switch packs, other byte order. |
| `DAT inside a .drs` | u32 count, u32 tail, pad, u32 offsets, 4-char extensions BIN/TPL/FCV/SEQ/EFF; Ganado packs share one 699-slot layout | gbox/re4gc_models.py (dat_read / dat_write), ModelPack | A BIN draws with the TPL after it, else the previous TPL; heads, eyes and hands are separate BINs. |
| `BIN / TPL` | BIN big-endian, 0x60 skinned / 0x40 rigid header, s16 positions with frac bits, s8 normals, 8-byte weight sets, materials with GX display lists (0x98 strip, 0x90 tris, 0x80 quads); TPL = standard GC (0x0020AF30) CMPR/IA8/I4 with pixels | gbox/re4gc_models.py (bin_read, tpl_read, cmpr_encode) | The game skins on the CPU from the weight index, so any topology works (unlike Switch same-topology edits). |

## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** A model change is a rebuilt disc image + relaunch. Session swap keep_state (save state -> relaunch -> load; live_link's RE4 GC player path) exists, but a restored state keeps the old model in RAM until the game reloads it (model-replacement-state.md).

**Pick whip: partial.** Generic only: pick_identify on gamecube walks RAM with GX display-list / vertex / matrix detectors; live-inject.md lists RE4 GC as 'slot guess / learned, generic, attempted' and nothing was injected live; replace falls back to build + session swap.

**Live controls:** re_mods (unlock_all, merc_loadout, weapon_mod, infinite_ammo, merc_time_bonus, combo_time, spawn_multiplier, explosive/super melee, auto_spin, aim_turn_speed); re4_gc_native facade (weapon pick, timer, native flash, grenade rings); re4_merc_bot

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- No model pointer is mapped: the player em and EmMgr slots carry no known pack/BIN field; cEm.Character (+0x3D0, decomp) is not read live.
- Live swap is a new disc image + relaunch; a restored save state keeps the old model in RAM; no verified RE4-specific RAM refresh.
- Pickwhip: no RE4 GC camera/entity profile for the picker; live_inject has never written a model into a running game.
- Byte budget: Disc 1 is full, so every rebuilt .drs must be <= its disc size (texture shrink, decimation) and padded to it.
- Enemies: em2a / em3e refused; non-humanoid skeletons give deformed meshes by design.
- Photo skin and Disc-2 builds have no recorded in-game check.
- Parked: operator 2026-11-10 - GameCube and Wii editions get no new work (Switch only).
